name: Finance · Microsoft OAuth Refresh Proof · Manual Read Only

parameters.content:
## Manual Microsoft OAuth refresh proof

Performs exactly one bounded Outlook Inbox read and one OneDrive root list. It does not download messages or files and cannot write to either provider.

Run once, capture only credential expiry/updatedAt metadata with the guarded operator readback, restart n8n, and run it again. Retain the two redacted receipts plus the metadata-only before/after readback. Never record credential data or tokens.

parameters.jsCode:
// Purpose: Emit terminal proof without message, file, identity, or credential data.
const outlook = $('Reduce Outlook to Redacted State').first().json;
const driveRows = $input.all().map(item => item.json).filter(row => row && row.id);
return [{
    json: {
        schema_version: 'microsoft-oauth-refresh-proof-receipt-v1',
        status: 'VERIFIED',
        execution_id: String($execution.id),
        outlook_read_succeeded: outlook.outlook_read_succeeded === true,
        outlook_items_observed: outlook.outlook_items_observed,
        outlook_max_messages: outlook.outlook_max_messages,
        outlook_server_filter_applied: outlook.outlook_server_filter_applied === true,
        outlook_window_start: outlook.outlook_window_start,
        outlook_window_end: outlook.outlook_window_end,
        onedrive_root_read_succeeded: true,
        onedrive_root_items_observed: driveRows.length,
        provider_writes: false,
        message_fields_recorded: false,
        file_fields_recorded: false,
        credential_values_recorded: false,
        token_values_recorded: false,
        production_workflows_activated: false,
        actual_writes: false,
        cashback_writes: false,
        verified_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    },
}];

nodeGroups.description: Finance stage 1. Freeze a seven-day window, perform at most one server-filtered Inbox read, and discard every message field.
